description: This Dart source file defines the AuthProvider class for managing authentication state in a Flutter application. It handles login, logout, session persistence, and realtime service integration, supporting both real backend and mock modes.

classes.name: AuthProvider
classes.description: Manages authentication state, handles login/logout, persists tokens, and interfaces with realtime services, supporting mock and real modes.

methods.name: AuthProvider._
methods.description: Private constructor initializing API and realtime service with provided clients.

methods.name: AuthProvider
methods.description: Factory constructor that creates an AuthProvider, wiring API and realtime services with token getter.

methods.name: AuthProvider._tokenGetter
methods.description: Static method to retrieve the current token from storage.

methods.name: loadSession
methods.description: Loads existing session data from local storage, initializes user info or mock user, and connects realtime service if applicable.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs login with given credentials, supports mock mode, stores token, sets user info, and connects realtime service.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears session tokens, user info, and disconnects realtime service.
